title: Badge Village
author: Kernelcon
description: Ready to get hands-on and go 'Off Grid'? Skip the screen and head to the Badge Village to master your powerful conference device! Discover what your badge can do and how to use it. Learn how to embark on the interactive narrative quest, which will guide you to unique challenges throughout the conference. Grab your parts, pick up a soldering iron, and level up your hardware skills by building an additional enhancement for your badge. Whether you're a seasoned maker or new to electronics, stop by the Village to learn, build, and prep for your adventure!

title: HAM Radio Village
author: Kernelcon
description:
Ham Radio has been considered to be the original form of hacking, launching before computers, integrated circuits, and even the transistor! Hams of all generations have a hacker mindset, solving problems their own way, regardless of what the manual has to say. Licensed hams are the only individuals legally authorized to build and modify their own transmitters! Continuing this pioneer spirit, the Ham Radio Village is here to support advancement of the hobby with a cybersecurity slant.

Everything we do today involves wireless communications of some sort, and a basic knowledge of how radio works is crucial. In the Ham Radio Village, you can learn hand-on with topics such as how to legally use a radio to send commands to a satellite, communicating around the globe when no other methods exist, and how to send and receive real-time location data without relying on any cellular networks. You can put your skills to the test by trying to find the hidden transmitters in the Ham Radio Fox Hunt contest, as well as transmitting memes over the airwaves to other attendees.

We provide license testing services for those looking to become licensed or upgrade their license class, as well as guidance on how to hack on the medium to achieve the best results and have the most fun!

title: Lockpicking Village
author: TOOOL
description: Tired of staring at a monitor trying to hack your way through a computer...come try your hand [literally] at hacking hardware! The Open Organisation Of Lockpickers [TOOOL] is set up and ready to give you a new kind of challenge. Gaining access has a different meaning here. TOOOL uses their knowledge to guide you through different types of locks, their vulnerabilities, and how to exploit them. Scrape pin tumblers instead of data!

title: Radio Hacking Outpost
author: Kernelcon
description: Visit the Kernelcon Radio Hacking Village to learn more about software defined radio applications.  There will be various radio & wifi hardware if anyone wants to get hands on experience and/or see real-time examples of wireless hacking. Wifi adapters, expoitable routers, RTL-SDRs, signal decoding and cloning.

title: Mental Health and Wellness Village
author: Mental Health Hackers
description: The Mental Health and Wellness Village offers a common place to allow like-minded individuals to share and grow as a community, to better our mental health and the health of those around us. Check out the village for fidget tables, crafts, adult coloring books, and more! Visit https://www.mentalhealthhackers.org/ for more information.
